methods.title: KESTREL: the kill-early study order. Each required study is an imperfect test of the liabilities it covers, with cited detection sensitivity; its kill probability is the noisy-OR chance of a decisive finding; studies are ordered by increasing cost (or time) per unit kill probability (the series-system ratio rule), subject to the ICH precedence between studies
assumptions: a programme clears only if no disqualifying liability fires: a series system, for which the expected-cost-minimising order of INDEPENDENT tests is increasing cost/P_kill (Mitten 1960; Unluyurt 2004)

P_kill(study) = 1 - product over covered liabilities k of (1 - pi_k * se_k), with pi_k the liability posterior and se_k the study's cited detection sensitivity for k (a lower bound: it counts only true decisive findings, as a negative animal result is near-uninformative, Bailey 2013)
study cost and duration are USER_SUPPLIED per CRO; where absent, flagged defaults are used and the order is reported as provisional

ICH precedence (dose range-finding before pivotal repeat-dose; bioanalytical validation before toxicokinetics) is a forest/series-parallel order, scheduled by a precedence-feasible greedy on the ratio (exact for series-parallel precedence by decomposition; Sidney 1975)
limits: decision support only: it never commissions, waives or reorders a study of record, and never enters a submission

the order is only as good as the cited sensitivities and the liability posteriors; both abstain rather than guess, and a study whose liabilities all abstain is listed without a ratio
general precedence-constrained sequencing is NP-hard (Lawler 1978); the ICH constraint set is series-parallel, so the greedy is exact for it

standing:
**In silico triage.** In silico triage is decision support for choosing and designing studies. It is not evidence and is never part of a study record or a submission. Where a method has been validated against a held-out set of real measured values its measured performance is shown with the signal and in its model card (docs/validation); where it has not, no accuracy is claimed for it.

**KESTREL study order.** KESTREL is decision support for the order in which to run studies to reach a go/kill decision at the lowest expected spend. It never commissions, waives or reorders a study of record, is never part of a submission, and claims no accuracy until a pre-registered, held-out validation is published. Cost and duration are the programme's own CRO inputs; where defaulted they are flagged and the order is provisional.
